Not sure what you mean, but if it's about missing quotes - it's fixed.
ACRP sounds like it's short for something, and "RP" really means "reference platform".  Please spell it out if you can.  If not, so be it.

At this moment no, the ASPEED ESPI driver is currently under review:
https://lore.kernel.org/all/20260313-upstream_espi-v1-0-9504428e1f43@aspeedtech.com/

I'm not familiar with community principles in such cases - is the preferred approach to remove this and add it once the change is merged upstream? Or since it's currently under review, is it fine to proceed?

BTW: I see that it already was included in OpenBMC: 
https://github.com/openbmc/openbmc/blob/87bef3f63d0097b0c27af1bd3c8a830f3fde72dc/meta-ibm/meta-system1/recipes-kernel/linux/linux-aspeed/system1.cfg#L1
